subject.title: feat: inspect background tasks across web and mobile

question: Should operator.read clients be allowed to retrieve bounded background-task prompt text through tasks.get?
rationale: The branch deliberately exposes previously unavailable user input through an existing broad read permission; source inspection can assess implementation quality, but only maintainers can confirm that privacy and authorization contract.

options.title: Approve bounded read access
options.body: Confirm operator.read is the intended boundary, retain the 4,000-character and internal-context stripping rules, and add focused authorization contract coverage before merge.

options.title: Use a narrower permission
options.body: Require a dedicated capability or stronger scope for prompt retrieval while leaving ordinary task summaries available to operator.read clients.

options.title: Ship without prompts
options.body: Land task history and output inspection across clients but omit prompt retrieval until the access model is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded read access
recommendation.body: Confirm operator.read is the intended boundary, retain the 4,000-character and internal-context stripping rules, and add focused authorization contract coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available cross-client and release-area owner connected to this feature and its intended operator experience.
